# hey-axi command reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-skill-reference.js from src/manifest.json (hey 1.7.0). Do not edit by hand. -->

Every command from HEY CLI 1.7.0 (151 runnable paths, including the `login`/`logout` aliases and shortcut forms such as `box <name>`). Run each as `hey-axi <command> [args] [flags]`.
`hey-axi <command> --help` lists the flags offline, and `hey <command> --help` gives HEY's full explanation and argument names.
Global flags that work with any command: `--account <id|all>`, `--json`, `--quiet`, `--ids-only`, `--count`, `--markdown`, `--html`, `--styled`, `--jq <expr>`.
